page.title: Settings
page.subtitle: Manage system settings, subscriptions, companies and users

system.title: System settings
system.ownerOnlyNotice: Only the company owner can change the system settings. You can view them, but not save changes.
system.languageInfo: Fiscal documents are always issued in Portuguese. Choose the interface language with the flag selector in the top-right corner.
system.timezoneHint: Used to show dates and times on screen, in documents and in exports
system.notificationEmailHint: Receives tax reminders and subscription confirmations, in addition to the owner's email
system.enableNotificationsHint: Off: tax reminders are no longer sent by email (they remain visible in the app). Payment and invoice emails are still sent.

subscription.title: Subscription management
subscription.selectHint: Select the company to view its subscription
subscription.lockedMessage: The system is locked. Choose a plan below to use all features again.

daysRemaining.one: {count} day left in the current period.
daysRemaining.other: {count} days left in the current period.

subscription.pastDueMessage: Please update your payment method to keep using the service.
subscription.noPlan: This company does not have an active plan yet. Choose one of the plans below to subscribe.
subscription.upgradeInfo: You can upgrade at any time. You cannot move to a lower plan, nor to a shorter period while the subscription is active.
subscription.downgradeBlockedShort: You cannot move to a lower plan
subscription.empty: Select a company to view its subscription and the available plans
subscription.shorterCycleBlockedShort: You cannot shorten the period while the subscription is active

users.title: User management
users.subtitle: Manage users and assign them to companies

documents.title: Document customisation
documents.description: Set the look of your invoices and receipts and the text of the messages sent to your clients. The settings apply to all documents of the selected company.

messages.ownerOnly: Only the company owner can change the system settings.
messages.sessionExpiredCreate: Your session has expired. Sign in again to create the company.
messages.deleteCompanyConfirm: Are you sure you want to delete the company "{name}"?
messages.removeAccessConfirm: Are you sure you want to remove this access?
messages.downgradeToTrial: You cannot go back to the free trial after subscribing to a paid plan.
messages.downgradeActive: Downgrading to a lower plan is not possible.
messages.shorterCycleBlocked: You cannot switch to a shorter period while the subscription is active.

documentTab.noCompany: Select a company to customise its documents.
documentTab.readOnly: Only the company owner or an administrator can change these settings.

template.title: Document template
template.subtitle: Choose the layout of your invoices, receipts and statements.

classico.label: Classic
classico.description: Logo on the left and a table with a grey header. This is the current look of your invoices.

moderno.label: Modern
moderno.description: Top band in the brand colour, with a centred logo and a striped table.

minimalista.label: Minimalist
minimalista.description: No backgrounds or bands. Just a thin rule in the brand colour and a table without a grid.

brand.title: Brand
brand.subtitle: The logo is shared with the company details.
brand.bankDetailsHint: Banks marked "Show on invoices" (main account first), M-Pesa and e-Mola appear at the bottom of invoices and statements. Edit them in the company details: Settings → Companies → edit → Bank details.
brand.noBankDetails: This company has no bank details yet, so nothing will be shown on documents.
brand.logoFormats: PNG or JPG, up to 2 MB.

texts.title: Document texts
texts.subtitle: Leave blank to show nothing.
texts.thankYouPlaceholder: E.g. Thank you for your business.
texts.defaultObservationsHint: Fills in the notes when creating a new invoice. Invoices already issued are not changed.

print.title: Printing
print.subtitle: Each copy is printed on its own labelled page.

email.title: Email messages
email.subtitle: Click a placeholder to insert it into the field you were typing in.
email.subject: Subject
email.statementHint: Use the statement placeholders, such as period and balance.
email.replyToHint: Client replies are forwarded to this address.

tokens.totalInvoiced: Statement: total invoiced in the period
tokens.totalPaid: Statement: total paid in the period
tokens.balance: Statement: balance owed at the end date

preview.title: Preview
preview.note: Sample data. Reflects your changes as you type, before saving.

messages.fileTooLarge: The file is too large. Maximum 2 MB.
